Results.ReviewText: By far the best grill we have ever owned. Heard up quickly and cooks evenly. The perfect size for our family.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I really like our new Spirit E-210 LP grill. We have never used the side gas burner on our previous gas grills, so not having one was actually a plus. However, we do use the side shelves, and having those was great, particularly the stainless steel feature as well as the easy ability to fold the shelves down. Also, with having casters on all 4 corners, plus the ability to collapse the one or both shelves made it so nice to roll back into place on our smallish back deck.  This was a major deal, as we do not have to put the grill on our patio which is down the stairs and further away.  This is our 1st Weber Grill and really like the Customer Support too.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill that doesn't take up a lota space

Results.ReviewText: Great smaller grill. Cooks evenly and plenty or space to cook for 6 people. I use about 3 times a week. My last Weber (Same model) lasted over 10 years. Great warranty.
Results.Title: Great Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: The Weber continues the tradition of high quality grill at a reasonable price.  After my first Weber was approaching 15 years of use I started looking for a replacement.  The Weber grills with easy to clean materials was the key selling point.
Results.Title: Clean and simple machine.

Results.ReviewText: I’m 64 yrs old and I purchased my first Weber grill.  Why didn’t I do this years ago?
Results.Title: First Weber ever

Results.ReviewText: We love the grill,but it is hard to get good sear marks on a steak.
Results.Title: Great

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We very sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with your new grill. Your grill is backed by a generous warranty and we will always stand behind our products. We suggest going over the maintenance section of your manual to keep your grill in the best shape possible. Our Care team will reach out to follow up. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The level of heat obtainable and controls are very good. The frame of the grill is very cheaply made. The cover is light duty. You cannot use the side tables to move the grill because they are weak. I have a six-year-old Weber spirit and the construction is much stronger. This grill probably won’t last longer than three or four years.
Results.Title: Some good some poor

Results.ReviewText:
After owning a Weber Q for 10 years when it wore out we knew We wanted another Weber.
We did our homework and decided on the E 210 we couldn’t be happier. We grill regularly for a small family & Weber product’s last ! Unlike some other brands! If you grill for larger crowds go with the E 310 but be willing to pay just a little more for a Weber it’s just worth it. It’ll still be there when some other brands are in the scrap heap & 10 or 15 years from now you’ll be glad you did!!!
Results.Title: Weber E 210

Results.ReviewText: I have always bought Weber products over a 50+ year period and still own my first two (different sizes) kettle grills.  I had an issue with a ten year old gas grill and did not give a high rating.  Weber immediately reached out and the issue was quickly resolved to my complete satisfaction. 5 stars to Weber and especially to customer service for ensuring my satisfaction.   I will never buy another brand.
Results.Title: Update earlier review to five stars

Results.ReviewText: Gets hotter than the 10 year old model being replaced.  Otherwise the same "trusted and true" Weber grill.
Results.Title: Great performance

Results.ReviewText: 2nd grill. Loved first grill we had for 3 years but it got tore up in Florida hurricane
Results.Title: Love Weber products

Results.UserLocation: San Francisco / Oakland Bay Area California
Results.ReviewText: Walnut Creek Ace Hardware is a great store. This unit was on sale. The guy who delivered it also assembled it; it was a great buying experience. The unit looks good and works perfectly. I love it. The Weber brand always meets my high expectations.
Results.Title: Great BBQ on sale.

Results.ReviewText: Great solid grill that heats up very quickly and cooks evenly. I don’t have anything negative to say.
Results.Title: Great solid grill

Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent small grill we purchased for a seasonal apartment. I was considering the E-310 because it is a 3 burner model but decided on the E-210 due to its size being a bit smaller. We have a Weber Genesis E-325 at home and getting a smaller grill I was concerned it wasn't going to heat up fast or get hot enough. The E-210 gets hot super fast and the temperature easily gets above 500F. Additionally I now prefer the cast grate to the stainless grates on the bigger more expensive unit. We grill 3-4 times a week. Couldn't be happier!
Results.Title: Great Grill and Perfect Size

Results.ReviewText: I had a Spirit 310 since 2014. It has been outstanding and reliable however the bottom pan was showing its age due to the fact we live on the NH seacoast. I really wanted a 2 burner grill  and my only choice was Weber. I have a Baby Q that I bought in 2002 and it's still working perfectly so Weber has earned my loyalty. I bought the Spirit 210 and it is built and cooks as well or better than my 310. I bought the Weber cover for it and undercoated the bottom of the pan so hopefully I can keep the salt air and water away from it.
Results.Title: Best grill on the market. Works, cooks flawlessly

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill about two weeks ago as the old grill had rusted out.  I have used the new grill several times.  It worked great.  When my son and I assembled it, there was one bolt missing.  I contacted Customer Service and the agent quickly agreed to send me a replacement bag of hardware.
Results.Title: Very Satisfied

Results.ReviewText: Really happy with the purchase and how well it heats up.  Great for grilling steaks and easy cleanup afterwards.  Buying quality makes a difference.  Folding side tables are a real bonus for storing in the garage when not in use.
Results.Title: Great size and compact

Results.ReviewText: My last Webber lasted 20 yrs. I was a little hesitant but this seems well built and functions great.
Results.Title: Replaced 20 year Webber

Results.ReviewText: Grill works fine, heats evenly & quickly.  Solid construction that should last a long time.
Results.Title: Happy So Far

Results.ReviewText:
A great size for just the two of us.  My only complaint is that the spacing on the grill grates is too far apart.  It works fine for standard chicken breasts or steaks, but KBobs or burgers tend to suffer.  Excellent grates, but it has been a learning process after my previous grill.
Temp control and everything else is fabulous.
Results.Title: Love it except...

Results.ReviewText: Love the quality of this grill, strong and stable I had other grills previously that were a little un stable that would shake side to side when cooking on it or moving it around, this by far is the best grill I have ever owned
Results.Title: Great grill heats up very quickly

Results.ReviewText: I love the way the Weber grills. It heats up quickly and cooks evenly. This is my 3rd Weber (in decades) and I remain loyal. The reason for one less star: within a couple weeks, the stainless steel has scattered rust spots and streaks.
Results.Title: Always get Weber

Results.ReviewText: I am impressed with how well made this Weber grill is.  It uses heavy-grade steel and shows well-engineered construction.  It should last for many years.
Results.Title: A well-made product

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my previous spirit grill after 13 years of use. The new grill works great!
Results.Title: My Second Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: Quality grill that takes a couple of hours to assemble. Size is perfect for small family. Functions well with no issues so far.
Results.Title: Glad we swapped to this smaller grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber E-210 gas grill. The first one -owned for 8 years- has been passed down to my son. Very reliable equipment.
Results.Title: Reliable gas grill

Results.ReviewText:
The 2 burner Weber is the perfect size. Big enough for family & friends, but small enough for almost everyday use for just me and my wife.
Very even heat!
Quick warm up!
Easy to ignite!
Excellent construction!
This my second Weber. The first one lasted over 15 years. Best grills I’ve ever had. I’ll never buy another brand.
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill!

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
